description: Shows the model years and the trim levels Ridekick lists for one make and model. `year` and `trim` narrow the trims, and `trimsYear` is the model year the trims are for. A new-car ask starts here: a buyer who asks for a new car of a make and model, with or without a model year, and has named no listing. `requests_preview` follows it. A buyer can also name only a kind of car, such as a 3-row SUV. Each make and model of that kind is one call, and needs no ZIP code or model year. These are the choices Ridekick lists for the model: they carry no dollar amounts, colors or options, and they say nothing about whether a car is for sale near the buyer. With the buyer's ZIP code and the year it returns the same choices and also one yes or no, `carsNearby`, for whether a car like the one described is listed near the buyer. That answer has no count, dealership, town, distance or dollar amount, and it is not a promise that a car is for sale. The drivetrain and fuel lists are empty without a ZIP code. With one, they can name the types listed near the buyer, with no count. The exterior color is one of these: Black, White, Gray, Silver, Red, Blue, Green, Brown, Gold or Orange. The interior color is the buyer's own words, not a list Ridekick holds. Each connection can ask a limited number of times a day, and the answer says when a limit is reached. Any connected assistant can use it; it needs no extra permission and shows nothing about the buyer. If `found` is false, Ridekick lists no such make and model.

drivetrain.description: Optional, with zip. A drivetrain to look for.

exteriorColor.description: Optional, with zip. The exterior color: one of Black, White, Gray, Silver, Red, Blue, Green, Brown, Gold or Orange. A call that gives one color and not the other is refused.

fuel.description: Optional, with zip. A fuel type to look for. A call with a ZIP code and no fuel can return the `fuels` listed near the buyer.

interiorColor.description: Optional, with zip. The buyer's own words for the interior color. A call that gives one color and not the other is refused.

radius.description: Optional, with zip. Miles from the buyer's ZIP, from 1 to 100. The default is 100.

trim.description: Optional. Narrows the trims to this trim. With zip, a trim to look for.

year.description: Optional for the choices; required with zip. Narrows the trims to this model year.

zip.description: Optional. The buyer's five-digit ZIP code. With it and year, you get a yes or no for cars near the buyer.

name: see_car_choices
title: See years and trims
